int_name: W HUNTING PARK AVE & SCHUYLER ST

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals, providing basic safety infrastructure. However, the wide crossing distance and lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions increase pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Exposure
hazards.description: The wide roadway width increases the time pedestrians are exposed to potential vehicle conflicts without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the left side of the street may obscure pedestrians waiting to cross from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Curb line on the left side of the image

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the crosswalks to ensure clear sight lines for both pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility crosswalks and pedestrian signals, providing basic infrastructure for walkers. However, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions or refuge islands result in long exposure times for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the corner may block the view between turning drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection near the parked cars

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with standard pedestrian infrastructure including high-visibility zebra crosswalks, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals. However, the wide curb radii and potential sightline obstructions from large vehicles or objects near the corner increase risk for crossing pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large blurred area on the right side of the image obscures sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Wide Curb Radius
hazards.description: The corner design allows for relatively high-speed vehicle turns, increasing the risk of collisions with pedestrians in the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and force drivers to take turns at slower speeds.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking or obstructions near the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for both drivers and pedestrians.
